metadata.title: Smoked pork with ITC sunrise Meat Masala
metadata.description:
Bring the flavors of Meghalaya to your kitchen with Jadoh, a traditional Khasi rice dish, and Smoked Pork Curry, made irresistible with ITC Sunrise Meat Masala! 🌾🔥

In this video:
✅ Step-by-step recipe for Jadoh.
✅ Smoky, spicy pork curry packed with authentic flavors.
✅ The magic of ITC Sunrise Meat Masala in action.

Try this recipe and taste the heart of Khasi cuisine!

👉 Like, comment, and subscribe for more Northeastern recipes!
#Jadoh #SmokedPorkCurry #ITCSunriseMasala #NortheastCuisine #CookingWithLove
